response.sql: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_avg FROM patient_ratios), above_overall AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, p.ratio - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM patient_ratios AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.overall_avg), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS second_avg FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(a.above_overall) AS average_above_overall, AVG(a.ratio - s.second_avg) AS average_above_second FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN second_average AS s WHERE a.ratio > s.second_avg;
